title: 産業・組織心理学
subtitle: Industrial and Organizational Psychology
educationalGoal: Students will learn about: (1) dynamics in an organization. (2) stress caused by the working environment. (3) motivation for work and human resource management.
advice: We will cover the following topics: 1. Organizational behavior 2. Motivation for work 3. Stress caused by the working environment 4. Workers' health and safety 5. Human resource management 6. Career development
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Elements of Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” courses is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand human behavior, cognition, and emotion in an organization.
Ability to understand and assess the characteristic traits of a leader in an organization.
Ability to understand psychological stress caused by the working environment.
Ability to consider career development for oneself.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
